prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a parking lot collision. The patient had 14 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1422; do not mention it.)
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of right shoulder pain, reduced range of motion, and intermittent numbness radiating into the right arm. Initial examination revealed tenderness over the anterior shoulder, limited active abduction and external rotation, and mild weakness on resisted testing. Imaging obtained at intake showed no fracture, with findings consistent with soft tissue strain and a partial rotator cuff injury.

Over the course of 14 visits, the patient participated in a structured program of physical therapy focused on passive and active range of motion, progressive strengthening of the rotator cuff and scapular stabilizers, and manual therapy to address soft tissue restriction. Anti-inflammatory medication and ice were used for symptom control during the early phase.

At the most recent visit, the patient reported substantial improvement in pain and function, with active range of motion approaching the unaffected side and strength near baseline. Residual mild discomfort with overhead activity persists. Continued home exercise and activity modification are recommended, with follow-up as needed for any recurrence of symptoms.
